note: This sprint adds to existing files only. No new files or directories are created.

files.role: Add get_labels_used_by_type method to existing LabelService class

methods.name: get_labels_used_by_type
methods.purpose: Return all distinct labels attached to at least one object of the given object_type, ordered by name ascending. Returns empty list if none found.

files.role: Add GET /api/labels/used route to existing router

methods.name: get_labels_used
methods.purpose: Handle GET /api/labels/used. Validate object_type (422 OBJECT_TYPE_REQUIRED if absent or blank), call LabelService.get_labels_used_by_type, return LabelSearchResponse.
